catalog.demotion_rule: An unserved conservative default MUST be measured in the same migration that first serves it. There is no serve-at-4-and-measure-later path: without this, the laundering risk returns as schedule pressure — a shipped action sitting at a conservative level with the measurement owed and nothing forcing it.

post_action_query.description: A bounded filtered accessibility read performed after the action. Omit this field to avoid the read cost.

post_action_state.description: Returned only when post_action_query was requested. Its read status is independent and never changes the enclosing action outcome.

read_after_action_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds from action dispatch to this read; this marker is not a claim that the action caused the state.

status.description: Outcome of the requested read only; a read failure does not turn a completed action into a failed action.

chord.description: The chord exactly as the caller wrote it when the hard-blocklist check refused it; callers need the original spelling to choose what to change, and this field is declared now for the hard-blocklist slice that follows so it does not require another vocabulary mint.

containment_forfeited_because.description: Which single condition denied a structural containment rung. Absent when none did. Nine typed conditions otherwise reduce to the rung alone, and a caller's remedy differs between them.

field.description: The request field that failed validation; callers need it to correct only the invalid part and it is present on invalid_request refusals.

posts_returned.description: The number of post calls that returned after the per-post process-generation check, present when a sequence was cancelled or interrupted mid-flight; it counts calls the kernel accepted, NOT keystrokes an application received, which no macOS API reports.

reason.description: The one-word code for the check that failed; callers need it to choose the remedy, and it is present on invalid_request and chord_blocked refusals.

remedy.description: What the caller should do next after a refusal; callers need it separately from the outcome so they can repair the request or authorization without guessing.

target_fronted.description: Whether the target was verifiably fronted across the dispatch bracket. Its own fact rather than a containment input: false does not mean the input escaped its process, it means the window that received it inside that process is not pinned down.

region.description: Rectangle cropped from the target window in the window's own pixels, with a top-left origin; single-window capture honors this rectangle.

windows_enumeration.description: Whether the window list this reply was built from was complete. A caller asking for target_windows cannot otherwise tell a complete set from a short one, and unknown is its own value because a module that could not determine completeness is making a different claim than either boolean.

attempts.description: Number of scoped reads performed before the wait ended.

outcome.description: Cancelled means the caller interrupted the wait; no further poll was attempted and the last observed predicate state is in evidence.

settle_path.description: Provenance of settlement; the current implementation polls until the predicate holds or its deadline expires.
